shared_elements: band or panel of repeated small signs
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief carved motifs including anthropomorphic imagery and repeated schematic signs arranged in horizontal registers, but that is about as far as it goes. A shows a monolithic three-dimensional human figure whose back bears a few large isolated emblems (a ring, curved bands, crescents), while B is a flat rectangular slab densely filled with many rows of small pictographic signs plus two kneeling figures facing inward at the lower corners — a wholly different organisational scheme and figural repertoire.
